articles.title: USACE Far East District completes turnover of $190 million in new housing facilities at Camp Humphreys
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Far East District, in partnership with the Republic of Korea Ministry of National Defense-Defense Installation Agency, completed the turnover of new unaccompanied enlisted personnel housing facilities Nov. 9, 2026, at Camp Humphreys.

articles.title: Projecting Lethality: 25th Infantry Division Validates Deep Strike Capabilities Across the Pacific
articles.summary: SCHOFIELD BARRACKS, Hawaii: The ability to rapidly project lethal, long-range fires across the vast expanse of the Pacific Ocean is a defining capability of the modern U.S. Army.

articles.title: Hawaii Army National Guard bids farewell to Tahara, welcomes Hogsten as new commander
articles.summary: The Hawaii Army National Guard hosted a change of command ceremony in Kapolei, Hawaii, Nov. 14, 2026, marking the official transfer of command from Brig. Gen. Tyson Y. Tahara to Brig. Gen. Ronald D. Hogsten.

articles.title: 75th USARIC Walks the Walk in Support of Suicide Awareness and Prevention
articles.summary: Soldiers assigned to the 75th U.S. Army Reserve Innovation Command and 1st Battalion, 289th Regiment, Training Support, gathered for a unit 2-mile walk and run dedicated to suicide prevention and awareness, Sept. 20, 2026.

articles.title: Kadena welcomes first permanently assigned F-15EX Eagle II aircraft
articles.summary: The first permanently assigned U.S. Air Force F-15EX Eagle II fighter aircraft arrived at Kadena Air Base, Japan, on Nov. 15, 2026, marking a major milestone in the 18th Wing's fighter modernization and the continued strengthening of U.S. airpower in the Pacific region.

articles.title: Operation Frozen Recovery: Alaska Soldiers Retrieve Historic Signal Corps Radio
articles.summary: Nine Soldiers assigned to Headquarters and Headquarters Detachment, 59th Signal Battalion, recovered a historic U.S. Army Signal Corps radio from the wreckage of a U.S. Air Force TB-29 bomber in Alaska, Aug. 10-11, 2026. The radio had remained at the crash site since 1957, when the aircraft went down during a training mission.

articles.title: Japan, U.S. participate in annual Joint Senior Leader Seminar
articles.summary: U.S. Pacific Command hosted the 2026 Joint Senior Leaders Seminar Nov. 13, bringing together American and Japanese defense officials to align strategic goals, coordinate operational planning and strengthen the defense alliance.
